Synopsis:
Italian state broadcaster RAI removed veteran investigative journalist Sigfrido Ranucci from flagship programme "Report" after nine years. The move follows controversy linked to a bombing outside his home and the arrest of a close associate who allegedly ordered the attack. Opposition parties decry political interference and press freedom violations; government allies praise the decision. The case highlights structural vulnerabilities in RAI's editorial independence, given its parliament/government-appointed board. Internal newsroom revolt threatens further disruption, with elections due next year adding political urgency.
